assets.name: 낡은 목재 초소
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent PNG building sprite for a fantasy tower defense game. Elevated orthographic 3/4 game view, detailed hand-painted 3D RPG artwork, crisp readable silhouette at 90px game size. Square canvas, ONE building centered, whole structure visible, generous transparent margin. Genuine transparent alpha background; NO landscape, backdrop, floor plane, UI, writing, characters, watermark or cast ground shadow. The building's footprint bottom at y88% and its blank front-facing circular dark wooden/metal sign centered x50%, y73% of the square; the game will overlay a letter there, so leave this round sign BLANK. Building sits on a small attached foundation only. This is one stage in a deliberately dramatic poor-to-grand evolution. Do not copy an elegant ivory crystal tower shape into every stage.
STAGE ONE, EXTREMELY POOR STARTER: a low, ramshackle makeshift wooden lookout hut, crooked mismatched brown planks, leaning rough posts tied with fraying rope, patchwork rag canopy, rusty brackets, tiny improvised wooden crossbow on top. No stone cylinder, no ornate metal, no glowing crystals, no gold, no grand spire. Visibly shabby and primitive but charming, sturdy enough to function. A few attached broken planks on a rough timber base. Squat asymmetrical silhouette, top begins near y40%; keep the upper 35% transparent, DO NOT enlarge the little hut to fill the canvas. The front blank round wood sign is near y73%. Earth brown and faded beige palette.
